data.name: Carmelina
data.long_meaning: Carmelina is derived from the Hebrew word 'karmel,' meaning 'mountain' or 'garden of God'. In the Bible, Mount Carmel is a significant location where the prophet Elijah defeated the prophets of Baal. This name symbolizes devotion, faith, and strength.

in_hebrew.name: קרמלינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קרמלינה (Karmelina) היא שם נשים נוצרי שמקורו בעברית, שמאוחר יותר נשמעה בעלי שמחה, בתור 'עלי' (fruit) של 'קרמל' (Carmel), שהוא שם כבוד לאלוהים. במסורת היהודית, רבי שמעון בן יוחאי נתן תואר 'עלי' (carmel) ל'מבטח' (the Rock) - ה' עצמו. בהקשר זה, שם נשים 'קרמלינה' (Karmelina) יכול לשקף את האושר, השמחה והבטחון באלוהים.

in_greek.name: Καρμελίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Καρμελίνα (Karmelina) είναι μια χριστιανική ονομασία γυναικών με εβραϊκή ρίζα, που φέρει το νόημα της χαράς και της ευτυχίας. Ο τίτλος 'Καρμέλ' (Carmel) ήταν προσφώνημα για τον Θεό κατά την εβραϊκή παράδοση, και η ονομασία Καρμελίνα (Karmelina) μπορεί να αντιπροσωπεύει την αισιοδοξία, την ευτυχία και την ασφάλεια στη Θεία παρουσία.

in_latin.name: Carmelina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen femininum Christianum Carmelina a radice Hebraea originem ducit, significans gaudium et felicitatem. In traditione Judaeorum, Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai titulum 'Carmel' (carmel) dedit Domino suo, qui ipse Deus est. Secundum contextum huius tituli, nomen femininum Carmelina (Carmelina) potest significare gaudeo, felicitas, et securitas in Deum.

in_english.name: Carmelina
in_english.meaning: fruit of Carmel, a girl's name symbolizing joy and happiness
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian feminine name Carmelina is derived from the Hebrew roots, conveying the meaning of joy, happiness, and the fruit of the spirit. In Jewish tradition, Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai referred to God as the 'Carmel', hence the name Carmelina (Carmelina) symbolizes the joy, happiness, and assurance one finds in God's presence.

biblical_reference.note: In the Bible, the Hebrew word 'karmel' is used to describe the beauty and fertility of the earth, and is also a title for God.

data.cultural_impact: Carmelina as a name has been popular in various Christian communities, particularly in Italy and Spain. Its connection to Mount Carmel in the Bible and the Carmelite Order has made it emblematic of strong faith, spiritual devotion, and commitment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Carmelina holds deep spiritual meaning for Christians as it is derived from the Hebrew word 'karmel', meaning 'mountain of God.' It signifies a strong connection with God and a commitment to maintain a devotional and virtuous life, drawing inspiration and strength from the Almighty.
